files.name: crickets
files.processing: Whole recording downmixed/resampled to mono 24 kHz PCM. Single constant gain; only end/start overlap 1.25 s. No internal editing, time stretching, denoising, wind removal, added sounds or runtime virtual loops.
files.windAssessment: Author explicitly describes recording as no wind; not independently verified by human listening.

processing: 録音全体を使用。モノラル24 kHz PCMへの変換と一定の音量調整。始端・終端のみ1.25秒クロスフェード。録音途中の切り貼り・風の除去加工・合成音の追加なし。
playback: Single continuous native buffer loop, no random excerpts or virtual loop. Summer/autumn evening/night only; silence otherwise. Existing distance gain, user volume, crossfade and lifecycle retained. Legacy wind-mixed assets preserved but never requested.
